0022600166.text: The Timberwolves host the Bucks in their eighth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 4-3 overall with a 2-1 home record, a 4-3 mark over their last ten games, and a one-game losing streak. Minnesota is 10th in the West and fourth in the Northwest, one game back, while Milwaukee is 1-5, 14th in the East, fifth in the Central and four games back, on a two-game losing streak. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery; 33.3 points per game this season), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), Terrence Shannon Jr. (out, hip bruise), and LaMelo Ball (day-to-day, wrist, a game-time decision), and the teams have not met yet this season, though Minnesota swept the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 139-106 win in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
